Game is a click-only adjacent-transfer alignment puzzle on an 8 px grid. Same-colored marker strips must align on the same column (horizontal layouts) or row (rotated vertical layouts); exact alignment of every marker pair completes the round. Blue pairs straddle black dividers. The two blue halves are opposite controls: a click shifts the two adjacent gray/white boundaries in opposite directions by one step, preserving their sum. For an edge pair: right-edge upper moves the inner/lower boundary right and the complementary boundary left; left-edge lower moves inner right. In bottom-edge vertical layouts, the LEFT blue half transfers 2 rows rightward: boundary on its left moves UP 2, boundary on its right moves DOWN 2; the right half reverses this. Boundaries have screen limits, so a transfer may be blocked; create capacity by transferring at the next divider. The pink top strip changes with moves and is part of the outer/reservoir visualization, not a simple click timer. Model current boundaries and solve flows linearly; sequence transfers to avoid bounds.
